summary.text: Strom Peterson is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives, representing District 21-Position 1 since January 12, 2015, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Peterson was assigned to the Capital Budget Committee, the Civil Rights & Judiciary Committee, the Community Safety, Justice, & Reentry Committee and the Housing Committee, which he chaired, during the 2023-2024 session, according to Ballotpedia.
